svg.title: Vogel spirals and angle discrepancy
svg.desc: 600 slots of the golden-angle spiral against 137.0, 138.0 and 120 degrees, dotted by arrival order, and the 1-D discrepancy of the angle sequence for N = 377 against the divergence angle.
svg.text: slot order: dark = early, yellow = late. A fixed angle per panel, spacing c, offset 0.5, 600 slots.
divergence angle as a fraction of a turn, α (the sequence is {nα}, n < 377)
Golden angle: N·D* = 1.00 at Fibonacci N (144, 377), 1.44 at 89, 233. Rational angles tower to ~N/q: the rays of the 120° panel.
D* = 1/(2N) + max |x(i) − (2i−1)/(2N)| for the sorted sample; 1/N is the least any set containing 0 can reach.
